description: This file defines a React component for a dialog that allows users to upload CSV files to overlay new charts (scatter, candlestick, bar) onto an existing Plotly chart. It includes functions for handling file input, parsing CSV data, configuring plot options, and generating new Plotly traces based on user input.

classes.name: OverlayChartDialog
classes.description: A React functional component providing a dialog interface for uploading CSV data to overlay on a Plotly chart.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Resets the dialog's form state and closes the dialog.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Validates CSV data, generates a new Plotly data trace with the uploaded CSV, adds it to the existing chart, and closes the dialog.
